title: kaphtor: tools and data for Linear A research and comparative Semitics
description:
An open record of Linear A, and a toolkit for comparative Semitics: a reconciled record of the Linear A inscriptions, proposed readings for their words and signs with their evidence and confidence tiers, tools for testing those readings against the corpus, a database of Semitic roots, and query tools for the corpora of the ancient Near East.

The record is browsable at linear-a.ai. The grammar of the libation formula it supports is Ya Diktu, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21903481.
